            current_b = prefix_b + edges[node - 2][2]
            while stack and stack[-1][0] > current_b:
                stack.pop()
            result[node - 1] = len(stack)
            stack.append((current_b, node))

                dfs(_, current_a, current_b)

        result = [0] * (n - 1)
        stack = [(0, 1)]
        for _, a, b in graph[1]:
            dfs(_, 0, 0)
